The leaked interlock error is noted as an observation, not a criterion failure.

The log shows the identical Edit tool call twice (duplicate old_string/new_string) due to the interlock retry; the first attempt errored out.
Status line read "Sautéed for 21s · done 2:18 AM" — whimsical spinner wording may confuse users scanning for status.
